title: Subscription based
body: Nothing gets your app deleted quicker than a subscription being subscription-based. Don’t even gives us a free version. No thanks.

title: Hyrule
body: Unless Ganon completely redesigned the kingdom while nobody was looking, this layout bears zero resemblance to any Hyrule I’ve ever traversed. If you don't have access to the authentic Zelda texture pack, it's honestly better not to bother. One star is the lowest I can go, but my heart says zero.

title: Would be nice to have a free tier
body: Would love to experience this without having to do a weekly or yearly pay so I can see if I like it. Yes there’s a 7 day free period but I know me and I’ll forget to cancel it if I don’t use it within that time period.

title: Wow
body: If you are a gamer this is a must have map. It makes looking at the maps fun and the themes are awesome.
